note: P4340 (Pro 29:4) — by justice a king builds up the land; who exacts gifts tears it down.

dims.v: just rule — by which a king builds up his land
the justice by which a king builds up and stabilises his land — righteous governance as the foundation of a nation's flourishing, the opposite of the bribe-taking that tears it down
(the exaction of bribes that ruins it, by contrast)
the just rule that builds where corruption destroys

mishpat (justice) — 'by JUSTICE a king builds up the land'; righteous rule founds and stabilises a nation, where the exaction of bribes tears it down. Justice is a kingdom's building; corruption its ruin (cf 29:14; 16:12).
